name: Hardware Monitor
author: groot
description: Live CPU / temperature readout in the bar; click for a detailed system panel (CPU cores, memory, thermals, GPUs, disks, network, top processes, battery).

barWidget.description: CPU% + temperature in the bar. Right-click / scroll expands it to add memory, GPU and battery; left-click opens the full system panel. Reads kernel sysfs/procfs only - no elevated privileges, no network access.

schema.label: Start expanded
schema.description: Show the memory / GPU / battery readouts in the bar too (also toggled at runtime with right-click or scroll).
